sentences.en: "Let me see .... Do you have tomato juice?" says Hiroshi.
sentences.zh: “让我看看……你有番茄汁吗？”广志说道。

sentences.en: She tried to squeeze the juice out of the orange.
sentences.zh: 她试着把橙子挤出汁来。

sentences.en: This juice would be even better with two ice cubes.
sentences.zh: 加两块冰的话，这果汁会更好喝。

senses.zh: (水果等)汁，液，果汁，细胞液，内在本质，汽油，唾液，体液
